card.name: Linking words in cancer indication headings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "after" or "following" right after a treatment-setting heading in oncology dosing text (e.g. "First-Line Treatment of"). Also the table divider after a study start date in trial listings.

modes.label: Of/after in indication headings
modes.description: A linking word follows a phrase like "Adjuvant Treatment" or a drug combination, just before the cancer type or mutation.
modes.example: NSCLC First-Line Treatment<< of>> NSCLC with EGFR Exon

modes.label: Divider after trial start date
modes.description: The table separator after a month and year in a study start date row of a trial record.

card.plain: It fires on the little word that links a treatment heading to the cancer it treats, like "of" in "Adjuvant Treatment of Breast Cancer".
